reason: The plugin primarily integrates ChatGPT/Codex subscription models into dsh through OAuth authentication and an external undocumented backend; human review is appropriate because it handles account tokens and the README identifies service-terms and account-restriction risks.

summaries.zh: 通过 OAuth 登录 ChatGPT/Codex 账号，并将订阅模型接入 dsh 的 codex-oauth 提供方，支持多轮对话和受支持的图片输入。
summaries.en: Connects ChatGPT/Codex subscription models to dsh through OAuth, with support for multi-turn conversations and supported image inputs.

capabilities: OAuth device-code login for ChatGPT/Codex accounts
Stores refresh and access tokens in the dsh credential store
Exposes a Codex model provider through dsh
Provides settings-page and HTTP routes for login, logout, and status
Forwards supported image inputs to the model provider
